scoring_scale.1: Little or no evidence; below role expectations
scoring_scale.3: Meets expectations for the target level

dimensions.name: Technical or functional capability
dimensions.criteria: Required skills, tools, methods, domain knowledge, and quality of delivered work

dimensions.name: Relevant experience and outcomes
dimensions.criteria: Scope, complexity, ownership, measurable impact, and progression

dimensions.name: Problem solving and execution
dimensions.criteria: Reasoning, prioritization, judgment, quality, and delivery discipline

dimensions.name: Communication and collaboration
dimensions.criteria: Clarity, stakeholder management, teamwork, and written communication

dimensions.name: Leadership and adaptability
dimensions.criteria: Influence, mentoring, ownership, learning speed, and response to change

kpi_guidance: Use role-specific KPIs as evidence prompts, not as automatic rejection rules.
Prefer quantified outcomes and scope over keyword counts.
Compare evidence with the selected seniority level.
Require human review before making a hiring decision.

roles.title: Software Engineer
core_responsibilities: Design, build, test, and maintain reliable software features
Translate product requirements into maintainable technical solutions
Review code, improve quality, and contribute to technical decisions
Monitor and resolve production issues with the team

roles.title: Data Analyst
core_responsibilities: Turn business questions into reliable analyses and dashboards
Clean, validate, and document data sources
Communicate insights and recommendations to stakeholders
Define and monitor business metrics

roles.title: Machine Learning Engineer
core_responsibilities: Develop, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models
Build reproducible training and data pipelines
Monitor model quality, drift, latency, and cost
Partner with product and engineering teams to ship AI capabilities

roles.title: Product Manager
core_responsibilities: Set product goals, strategy, and prioritized roadmaps
Understand customer needs through research and data
Align design, engineering, sales, and operations stakeholders
Measure outcomes and iterate on shipped products

roles.title: UX/UI Designer
core_responsibilities: Research user needs and define information architecture
Create flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished interfaces
Validate designs through usability testing and feedback
Maintain accessible and consistent design systems

roles.title: DevOps / Cloud Engineer
core_responsibilities: Automate build, release, infrastructure, and operational workflows
Design secure, scalable, and cost-aware cloud environments
Improve observability, reliability, and incident response
Enable engineering teams through platforms and self-service tooling

roles.title: Digital Marketing Manager
core_responsibilities: Plan and execute multi-channel acquisition campaigns
Own messaging, content calendars, and campaign experiments
Analyze funnel performance and optimize spend
Coordinate agencies, creative teams, and sales enablement

roles.title: Account Executive
core_responsibilities: Develop pipeline and qualify business opportunities
Run discovery, demonstrations, negotiations, and closing
Build trusted relationships with economic buyers and champions
Maintain accurate forecasts and CRM records

roles.title: People Operations Specialist
core_responsibilities: Administer employee lifecycle processes and HR programs
Support policy, compliance, documentation, and employee inquiries
Coordinate onboarding, engagement, and performance processes
Maintain accurate people data and produce HR insights

roles.title: Financial Analyst
core_responsibilities: Prepare budgets, forecasts, and management reporting
Analyze variance, profitability, and business performance
Build financial models for planning and investment decisions
Present clear recommendations to business leaders

roles.title: Project Manager
core_responsibilities: Plan scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, and resources
Coordinate cross-functional delivery and stakeholder communication
Track decisions, actions, budget, and delivery health
Drive continuous improvement and successful project closure
